sara.sales: Quick question — need approval for a multi-region Dedicated commit for ACME. 6-month, 48 A100-equivalent GPU-hours reserved per region (us-east1 + europe-west1). They want autoscale with burst to 72 units for short periods. Customer needs a POC in ~2 weeks. Is a discount / special burst-rate approval possible? cc @deal-desk
josh.revenue: Can you paste the proposed $ numbers and commit terms? We need ARR and committed spend to evaluate.
sara.sales: Proposal: $120k monthly committed for both regions combined (so ~$60k/region). Asking for an 18% discount off standard reserved rate, and a capped burst rate equal to 1.5x the reserved unit price for POC only. POC expected to push ~5M tokens/day during test week.
olga.finance: Need unit-econ impact and a quick estimate of burst exposure. Also legal will need addendum language for POC exception. @pricing-bot can you run a quick calc?
pricing-bot: Quick estimate: Reserved baseline cost @ proposed commit = $96k/mo at expected load. Burst exposure (1.5x cap, 30% of peak) ~= +$14k/mo. Estimated margin hit ~7% (very rough). Subject to validation by finance.
matt.eng: From infra perspective: autoscale is OK, but multi-region burst guarantees are risky. eu-west has limited spare capacity in our current pool — if they require guaranteed 1.5x we either reserve extra or accept potential throttling. For POC we can allow best-effort burst.
anita.pd: Recommend canary the POC in us-east and only enable eu-west burst after we validate. Also document rollback/fallback behavior in SOW.
sara.sales: Sounds reasonable. Can we approve a temporary exception to the standard burst billing policy just for the POC (30 days)? Finance + deal-desk sign-off required.
olga.finance: We can approve a POC exception (max 30 days) with conditions: 1) capped burst invoice reconciliation, 2) invoice holdback clause pending POC acceptance, 3) signed addendum. Need legal to draft the addendum. Tagging @deal-desk for pricing authorization.
deal-desk: Provisionally approve: reduce discount to 12% on the commit (instead of 18%), allow POC burst cap at 1.5x for up to 30 days. Final approval once SOW + SOW numbers are submitted and legal adds addendum text. Please include a concise risk note for finance.
sara.sales: Thanks — I'll put together the SOW and SOW numbers and drop here later today. Can someone paste the recommended addendum language we should attach? Short snippet is fine.
ruan.sre: Addendum snippet: "During the POC period (maximum 30 days), Customer may exceed reserved capacity up to 1.5x without penalty. Production usage after the POC period is subject to standard burst billing and is subject to capacity availability. Redwood may throttle or route traffic if capacity is constrained; customer will be notified prior to any enforced throttling." Happy to review final wording.
olga.finance: :thumbsup: That works. Once SOW is in, I'll validate the numbers, sign-off and route to billing to create a special price code for the POC.
josh.revenue: One more ask — capture the committed ARR in RevOps and set a 30-day review trigger to decide conversion path post-POC.
sara.sales: Will do. Thanks everyone — looping legal next and will post SOW here by EOD.
